original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')       and i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH
  d1_filtered AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
  ),
  item_filtered AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
    FROM item
    WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
      AND i_manager_id IN (3, 15, 17, 26, 43, 44, 55, 70, 82, 95)
  ),
  customer_filtered AS (
    SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_hdemo_sk
    FROM customer
    WHERE c_current_addr_sk IN (
      SELECT ca_address_sk
      FROM customer_address
      WHERE ca_state IN ('IN', 'LA', 'NE', 'NM', 'OH')
    )
  ),
  warehouse_store_filtered AS (
    SELECT w.w_warehouse_sk, s.s_state
    FROM warehouse w
    JOIN store s ON w.w_state = s.s_state
  )
SELECT
  cd.cd_gender,
  cd.cd_marital_status,
  cd.cd_education_status,
  hd.hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
  store_sales ss
  JOIN item_filtered i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN d1_filtered d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN inventory inv ON inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
  JOIN warehouse_store_filtered ws ON inv.inv_warehouse_sk = ws.w_warehouse_sk
  JOIN customer_filtered c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN web_sales w_sales ON w_sales.ws_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    AND w_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    AND w_sales.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
    AND w_sales.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON w_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' day)
GROUP BY
  cd.cd_gender,
  cd.cd_marital_status,
  cd.cd_education_status,
  hd.hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY
  cnt;

original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')       and i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            ss_item_sk,
            ss_sold_date_sk,
            ss_customer_sk,
            ss_quantity
        FROM store_sales
        WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    ) ss
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            ws_item_sk,
            ws_sold_date_sk,
            ws_bill_customer_sk,
            ws_warehouse_sk
        FROM web_sales
        WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 31 AND 51
          AND ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ws_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
          AND ws_warehouse_sk IS NOT NULL
    ) ws ON ss.ss_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
           AND ss.ss_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_year = 2001
    ) d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
        FROM date_dim
    ) d2 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
           AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1.d_date AND (d1.d_date + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            i_item_sk
        FROM item
        WHERE i_category IN ('Electronics', 'Jewelry', 'Music')
          AND i_manager_id IN (6, 10, 21, 31, 34, 57, 70, 73, 85, 96)
    ) i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            inv_item_sk,
            inv_date_sk,
            inv_warehouse_sk,
            inv_quantity_on_hand
        FROM inventory
    ) inv ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
            AND inv.inv_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
            AND inv.inv_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
            AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss.ss_quantity
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT w_warehouse_sk, w_state
        FROM warehouse
    ) w ON ws.ws_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT s_store_sk, s_state
        FROM store
    ) s ON s.s_state = w.w_state
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            c_customer_sk,
            c_current_cdemo_sk,
            c_current_hdemo_sk,
            c_current_addr_sk
        FROM customer
    ) c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            cd_demo_sk,
            cd_gender,
            cd_marital_status,
            cd_education_status
        FROM customer_demographics
    ) cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT
            hd_demo_sk,
            hd_vehicle_count
        FROM household_demographics
    ) hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT ca_address_sk
        FROM customer_address
        WHERE ca_state IN ('FL', 'MO', 'PA', 'SC', 'TX')
    ) ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
GROUP BY
    cd_gender,
    cd_marital_status,
    cd_education_status,
    hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY cnt

original_query: select      cd_gender,     cd_marital_status,     cd_education_status,     hd_vehicle_count,     count(*) as cnt from     store_sales,     web_sales,     date_dim d1,     date_dim d2,     customer,     inventory,     store,     warehouse,     item,     customer_demographics,     household_demographics,     customer_address     where       ss_item_sk = i_item_sk       and ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk       and ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk 			and d2.d_date between d1.d_date and (d1.d_date + interval '30' day)       and ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk       and ws_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk       and inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk       and inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk       and inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity       and s_state = w_state       AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Men')       and i_manager_id IN (9, 24, 27, 41, 59, 66, 78, 80, 83, 100)       and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk       and c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk       and c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk       and ca_state in ('AL', 'MI', 'MS', 'OH', 'TX')       and d1.d_year = 2001       and ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 8 AND 28     group by cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, hd_vehicle_count     order by cnt     ;
rewritten_query:
WITH d1_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
d2_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-01-01'::date AND '2001-12-31'::date + INTERVAL '30 days'
),
item_filtered AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_manager_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Men')
    AND i_manager_id IN (9, 24, 27, 41, 59, 66, 78, 80, 83, 100)
),
ca_filtered AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('AL', 'MI', 'MS', 'OH', 'TX')
),
warehouse_filtered AS (
  SELECT w_warehouse_sk, w_state
  FROM warehouse
),
store_filtered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s_state
  FROM store
)
SELECT
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  hd_vehicle_count,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM
  item_filtered
  INNER JOIN store_sales ON ss_item_sk = item_filtered.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN d1_filtered ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1_filtered.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN inventory ON inv_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND inv_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
    AND inv_quantity_on_hand >= ss_quantity
  INNER JOIN warehouse_filtered ON inv_warehouse_sk = warehouse_filtered.w_warehouse_sk
  INNER JOIN web_sales ON ws_item_sk = ss_item_sk
    AND ws_warehouse_sk = inv_warehouse_sk
    AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 8 AND 28
  INNER JOIN d2_filtered ON ws_sold_date_sk = d2_filtered.d_date_sk
    AND d2_filtered.d_date BETWEEN d1_filtered.d_date AND (d1_filtered.d_date + INTERVAL '30 days')
  INNER JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    AND ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  INNER JOIN ca_filtered ON c_current_addr_sk = ca_filtered.ca_address_sk
  INNER JOIN customer_demographics ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
  INNER JOIN household_demographics ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
  CROSS JOIN store_filtered
WHERE store_filtered.s_state = warehouse_filtered.w_state
GROUP BY
  cd_gender,
  cd_marital_status,
  cd_education_status,
  hd_vehicle_count
ORDER BY
  cnt

original_query: with customer_total_return as (select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk ,sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk ,sum(SR_REFUNDED_CASH) as ctr_total_return from store_returns ,date_dim where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year =2001 and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 236 and 295 group by sr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk)  select  c_customer_id from customer_total_return ctr1 ,store ,customer ,customer_demographics where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return)*1.2 from customer_total_return ctr2 where ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk ) and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31 and s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk and s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI') and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'W') and cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College') and cd_gender = 'M' and c_birth_month = 5 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956 order by c_customer_id limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_store_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    sr_customer_sk,
    sr_store_sk,
    sr_reason_sk,
    sr_refunded_cash
  FROM store_returns
  INNER JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year = 2001
    AND sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 236 AND 295
    AND sr_reason_sk BETWEEN 28 AND 31
),
customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
    sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
    sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
    SUM(sr_refunded_cash) AS ctr_total_return
  FROM filtered_store_returns
  GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk
),
store_avg_return AS (
  SELECT 
    ctr_store_sk,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_threshold
  FROM customer_total_return
  GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN store_avg_return sar ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = sar.ctr_store_sk
INNER JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
INNER JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sar.avg_threshold
  AND s_state IN ('MI', 'NC', 'WI')
  AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
  AND cd_education_status IN ('4 yr Degree', 'College')
  AND cd_gender = 'M'
  AND c_birth_month = 5
  AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1956
ORDER BY c_customer_id
LIMIT 100

original_query: with customer_total_return as (select sr_customer_sk as ctr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk as ctr_store_sk ,sr_reason_sk as ctr_reason_sk ,sum(SR_RETURN_AMT) as ctr_total_return from store_returns ,date_dim where sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year =2001 and sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity between 182 and 241 group by sr_customer_sk ,sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk)  select  c_customer_id from customer_total_return ctr1 ,store ,customer ,customer_demographics where ctr1.ctr_total_return > (select avg(ctr_total_return)*1.2 from customer_total_return ctr2 where ctr1.ctr_store_sk = ctr2.ctr_store_sk ) and ctr1.ctr_reason_sk BETWEEN 24 AND 27 and s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk and s_state IN ('IA', 'NE', 'TX') and ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_marital_status IN ('S', 'U') and cd_education_status IN ('Secondary', '4 yr Degree') and cd_gender = 'F' and c_birth_month = 6 and c_birth_year BETWEEN 1934 AND 1940 order by c_customer_id limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT 
        sr_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        sr_store_sk AS ctr_store_sk,
        sr_reason_sk AS ctr_reason_sk,
        SUM(sr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM store_returns
    INNER JOIN date_dim ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2001
      AND sr_reason_sk BETWEEN 24 AND 27
      AND sr_return_amt / sr_return_quantity BETWEEN 182 AND 241
    GROUP BY sr_customer_sk, sr_store_sk, sr_reason_sk
),
store_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        ctr_store_sk,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_threshold
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_store_sk
)
SELECT c_customer_id
FROM customer_total_return ctr1
INNER JOIN store_avg sa ON ctr1.ctr_store_sk = sa.ctr_store_sk
INNER JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ctr1.ctr_store_sk
INNER JOIN customer ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_demographics ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > sa.avg_threshold
  AND s_state IN ('IA', 'NE', 'TX')
  AND cd_marital_status IN ('S', 'U')
  AND cd_education_status IN ('Secondary', '4 yr Degree')
  AND cd_gender = 'F'
  AND c_birth_month = 6
  AND c_birth_year BETWEEN 1934 AND 1940
ORDER BY c_customer_id

  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_customer_demographics AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
     OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree')
     OR (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College')
),
filtered_household_demographics AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk, hd_dep_count
  FROM household_demographics
  WHERE hd_dep_count IN (1, 3)
),
filtered_customer_address AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_state
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
    AND ca_state IN ('IN', 'NM', 'VA', 'MT', 'OH', 'OR', 'GA', 'IL', 'TX')
)
SELECT 
  min(ss_quantity),
  min(ss_ext_sales_price),
  min(ss_ext_wholesale_cost),
  min(ss_ext_wholesale_cost)
FROM store_sales
JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
JOIN store ON s_store_sk = ss_store_sk
JOIN filtered_customer_demographics ON cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk
JOIN filtered_household_demographics ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk
JOIN filtered_customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
WHERE (
  (cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'College' 
   AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00 AND hd_dep_count = 3)
  OR
  (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = '2 yr Degree' 
   AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 AND hd_dep_count = 1)
  OR
  (cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College' 
   AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00 AND hd_dep_count = 1)
)
AND (
  (ca_state IN ('IN', 'NM', 'VA') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
  OR
  (ca_state IN ('MT', 'OH', 'OR') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
  OR
  (ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'TX') AND ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
)

WITH filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Jewelry')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 28 AND 37
),
store_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT iss.i_brand_id, iss.i_class_id, iss.i_category_id
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN filtered_item iss ON ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  WHERE d1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
catalog_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN filtered_item ics ON cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  WHERE d2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
web_qualified AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN filtered_item iws ON ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  WHERE d3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
    AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
),
intersected_items AS (
  SELECT i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM store_qualified
  INTERSECT
  SELECT i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM catalog_qualified
  INTERSECT
  SELECT i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM web_qualified
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_sk
  FROM filtered_item fi
  JOIN intersected_items ii
    ON fi.i_brand_id = ii.i_brand_id
    AND fi.i_class_id = ii.i_class_id
    AND fi.i_category_id = ii.i_category_id
),
target_week_1999 AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5
  LIMIT 1
),
target_week_1998 AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 5
  LIMIT 1
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(sales_value) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity * ss_list_price AS sales_value
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim dd1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = dd1.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd1.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity * cs_list_price AS sales_value
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim dd2 ON cs_sold_date_sk = dd2.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd2.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity * ws_list_price AS sales_value
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim dd3 ON ws_sold_date_sk = dd3.d_date_sk
    WHERE dd3.d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
      AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  ) x
),
this_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
         fi.i_brand_id,
         fi.i_class_id,
         fi.i_category_id,
         SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
         COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN cross_items ci ON ss_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_item fi ON ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim dd ON ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN target_week_1999
  WHERE dd.d_week_seq = target_week_1999.d_week_seq
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
),
last_year AS (
  SELECT 'store' AS channel,
         fi.i_brand_id,
         fi.i_class_id,
         fi.i_category_id,
         SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) AS sales,
         COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN cross_items ci ON ss_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_item fi ON ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim dd ON ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
  CROSS JOIN target_week_1998
  WHERE dd.d_week_seq = target_week_1998.d_week_seq
    AND ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY fi.i_brand_id, fi.i_class_id, fi.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss_quantity * ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
)
SELECT
  this_year.channel AS ty_channel,
  this_year.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
  this_year.i_class_id AS ty_class,
  this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,
  this_year.sales AS ty_sales,
  this_year.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
  last_year.channel AS ly_channel,
  last_year.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
  last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
  last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
  last_year.sales AS ly_sales,
  last_year.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM this_year
JOIN last_year
  ON this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id
  AND this_year.i_class_id = last_year.i_class_id
  AND this_year.i_category_id = last_year.i_category_id
ORDER BY ty_channel, ty_brand, ty_class, ty_category
LIMIT 100;

),

  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 13
  LIMIT 1
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 23
),
date_range AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.i_item_sk
  FROM filtered_item i
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_range dr1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr1.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item iss ON ss.ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
      AND iss.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    INNER JOIN date_range dr2 ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr2.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item ics ON cs.cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
    WHERE cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
      AND ics.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_sales ws
    INNER JOIN date_range dr3 ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr3.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN item iws ON ws.ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
      AND ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
  )
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales
    INNER JOIN date_range dr ON ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    INNER JOIN date_range dr ON cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 78 AND 98
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price

WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Children', 'Men', 'Women')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 49 AND 58
),
intersect_brands AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT iss.i_brand_id, iss.i_class_id, iss.i_category_id
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN filtered_item iss ON ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
  INTERSECT
  SELECT DISTINCT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN filtered_item ics ON cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_dim d2 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
  INTERSECT
  SELECT DISTINCT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN filtered_item iws ON ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_dim d3 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
),
cross_items AS (
  SELECT fi.i_item_sk
  FROM filtered_item fi
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM intersect_brands ib
    WHERE fi.i_brand_id = ib.i_brand_id
      AND fi.i_class_id = ib.i_class_id
      AND fi.i_category_id = ib.i_category_id
  )
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT AVG(quantity * list_price) AS average_sales
  FROM (
    SELECT ss_quantity AS quantity, ss_list_price AS list_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_quantity AS quantity, cs_list_price AS list_price
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_quantity AS quantity, ws_list_price AS list_price
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN filtered_date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
  ) x
),
week_seq_this_year AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9
),
week_seq_last_year AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12 AND d_dom = 9
),
this_year AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
    COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN filtered_item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN week_seq_this_year wty ON d.d_week_seq = wty.d_week_seq
  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cross_items ci WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk)
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
),
last_year AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_brand_id,
    i.i_class_id,
    i.i_category_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) AS sales,
    COUNT(*) AS number_sales
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN filtered_item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN week_seq_last_year wly ON d.d_week_seq = wly.d_week_seq
  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cross_items ci WHERE ss.ss_item_sk = ci.i_item_sk)
  GROUP BY i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id
  HAVING SUM(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_list_price) > (SELECT average_sales FROM avg_sales)
)
SELECT
  'store' AS ty_channel,
  this_year.i_brand_id AS ty_brand,
  this_year.i_class_id AS ty_class,
  this_year.i_category_id AS ty_category,
  this_year.sales AS ty_sales,
  this_year.number_sales AS ty_number_sales,
  'store' AS ly_channel,
  last_year.i_brand_id AS ly_brand,
  last_year.i_class_id AS ly_class,
  last_year.i_category_id AS ly_category,
  last_year.sales AS ly_sales,
  last_year.number_sales AS ly_number_sales
FROM this_year
JOIN last_year
  ON this_year.i_brand_id = last_year.i_brand_id
  AND this_year.i_class_id = last_year.i_class_id
  AND this_year.i_category_id = last_year.i_category_id
ORDER BY this_year.i_brand_id, this_year.i_class_id, this_year.i_category_id
LIMIT 100

简化intersect_brands的构造：当前通过3个sales_base CTE各自JOIN后再INTERSECT，产生3次大表扫描+中间结果去重。改为单次扫描方案：SELECT i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id FROM filtered_item WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM store_sales ss JOIN filtered_date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk WHERE ss.ss_item_sk=filtered_item.i_item_sk AND ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43) AND EXISTS (...catalog_sales...) AND EXISTS (...web_sales...)。利用半连接提前过滤，减少物化成本。

优化cross_items的使用方式：当前this_year/last_year都通过'JOIN cross_items ci ON ss.ss_item_sk = ci.ss_item_sk'过滤，但cross_items是从filtered_item派生的。改为直接在主查询中使用filtered_item并添加EXISTS子句验证三渠道都有销售，避免物化cross_items CTE。具体：将'JOIN cross_items'改为'JOIN filtered_item'，并在WHERE中添加'AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intersect_brands ib WHERE i.i_brand_id=ib.i_brand_id...)'。

下推wholesale_cost过滤到索引扫描：当前所有Seq Scan都带Filter(wholesale_cost BETWEEN 23 AND 43)，导致全表扫描后过滤。虽然索引不包含wholesale_cost列，但可通过Index Scan on idx_store_sales_sold_date获取date过滤后的候选行，再Filter wholesale_cost，减少扫描行数。需在filtered_date_dim CTE中收紧日期范围(当前1998-2000太宽泛)，配合ANALYZE统计信息引导优化器选择索引。

合并this_year和last_year的扫描：当前两个CTE分别扫描store_sales(cost 945K*2)，仅week_seq条件不同。改为单个CTE同时计算两年数据：SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand_id, ..., SUM(...) FILTER(WHERE d.d_year=1999) as ty_sales, SUM(...) FILTER(WHERE d.d_year=1998) as ly_sales, ... GROUP BY d.d_year, i_brand_id, ... HAVING ty_sales > avg AND ly_sales > avg。最终结果自连接d_year=1999和1998的行，代价减半。

裁剪filtered_date_dim的冗余列：当前CTE投影(d_date_sk, d_week_seq, d_year)但多数JOIN只用d_date_sk，d_year仅用于范围过滤(已在CTE内完成)。将filtered_date_dim简化为SELECT DISTINCT d_date_sk WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2000，week_seq相关逻辑移到week_seq_this_year/last_year CTE中(已正确)。减少Hash表大小和JOIN开销。

UNION ALL SELECT 'CS' as channel, ... UNION ALL SELECT 'WS' as channel, ...) GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT channel)=3)。单次聚合完成3渠道交集判断，避免中间排序。

original_query: select  i_item_id,         ca_country,         ca_state,         ca_county,         avg( cast(cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) agg1,         avg( cast(cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) agg2,         avg( cast(cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) agg3,         avg( cast(cs_sales_price as decimal(12,2))) agg4,         avg( cast(cs_net_profit as decimal(12,2))) agg5,         avg( cast(c_birth_year as decimal(12,2))) agg6 from catalog_sales, customer_demographics, customer, customer_address, date_dim, item where cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and       cs_item_sk = i_item_sk and       cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and       cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk and       cd_gender = 'F' and       cd_education_status = 'College' and       c_current_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and       d_year = 2001 and       c_birth_month = 5 and       ca_state in ('MT', 'OH', 'OR')       and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 84 AND 89       AND i_category = 'Jewelry'  group by rollup (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county)  order by ca_country,         ca_state,         ca_county, 	i_item_id  limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_date AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category = 'Jewelry'
),
filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_education_status = 'College'
),
filtered_customer AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_addr_sk, c_birth_year
  FROM customer
  WHERE c_birth_month = 5
),
filtered_ca AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('MT', 'OH', 'OR')
)
SELECT
  fi.i_item_id,
  fca.ca_country,
  fca.ca_state,
  fca.ca_county,
  AVG(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg1,
  AVG(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg2,
  AVG(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg3,
  AVG(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg4,
  AVG(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg5,
  AVG(CAST(fc.c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg6
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN filtered_date fd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_item fi ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
JOIN filtered_cd fcd ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = fcd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN filtered_customer fc ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = fc.c_customer_sk
JOIN filtered_ca fca ON fc.c_current_addr_sk = fca.ca_address_sk
WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 84 AND 89
GROUP BY ROLLUP(fi.i_item_id, fca.ca_country, fca.ca_state, fca.ca_county)
ORDER BY fca.ca_country, fca.ca_state, fca.ca_county, fi.i_item_id
LIMIT 100

  AVG(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))) AS agg2,

FROM catalog_sales cs

WITH frequent_ss_items AS (
  SELECT 
    substring(i.i_item_desc, 1, 30) AS itemdesc,
    i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
    d.d_date AS solddate,
    count(*) AS cnt
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 2001
  JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk 
    AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 77 AND 96 
    AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Jewelry', 'Sports')
  GROUP BY substring(i.i_item_desc, 1, 30), i.i_item_sk, d.d_date
  HAVING count(*) > 4
),
max_store_sales AS (
  SELECT max(csales) AS tpcds_cmax
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      c.c_customer_sk,
      sum(ss.ss_quantity * ss.ss_sales_price) AS csales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 2001
    WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 2 AND 12
    GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk
  ) tmp1
),
best_ss_customer AS (
  SELECT c.c_customer_sk

),
frequent_items_distinct AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT item_sk FROM frequent_ss_items WHERE item_sk IS NOT NULL
),
best_customers_distinct AS (

)

FROM (

  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
    AND d.d_year = 2001 
    AND d.d_moy = 10
  JOIN frequent_items_distinct fid ON cs.cs_item_sk = fid.item_sk
  JOIN best_customers_distinct bcd ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = bcd.c_customer_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 2 AND 12

  FROM web_sales ws

  JOIN frequent_items_distinct fid ON ws.ws_item_sk = fid.item_sk
  JOIN best_customers_distinct bcd ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = bcd.c_customer_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 2 AND 12
) tmp2
LIMIT 100;

original_query: select   i_item_id  ,i_item_desc  ,s_store_id  ,s_store_name  ,sum(ss_net_profit) as store_sales_profit  ,sum(sr_net_loss) as store_returns_loss  ,sum(cs_net_profit) as catalog_sales_profit  from  store_sales  ,store_returns  ,catalog_sales  ,date_dim d1  ,date_dim d2  ,date_dim d3  ,store  ,item  where  d1.d_moy = 8  and d1.d_year = 2001  and d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk  and i_item_sk = ss_item_sk  and s_store_sk = ss_store_sk  and ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk  and ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk  and ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number  and sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk  and d2.d_moy               between 8 and  8 + 2  and d2.d_year              = 2001  and sr_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk  and sr_item_sk = cs_item_sk  and cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk  and d3.d_moy               between 8 and  8 + 2  and d3.d_year              = 2001  group by  i_item_id  ,i_item_desc  ,s_store_id  ,s_store_name  order by  i_item_id  ,i_item_desc  ,s_store_id  ,s_store_name  limit 100;

WITH d1_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_moy = 8 AND d_year = 2001
),
d2_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 8 AND 10 AND d_year = 2001
),
d3_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_moy BETWEEN 8 AND 10 AND d_year = 2001
),
ss_projected AS (
  SELECT ss_sold_date_sk, ss_item_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_net_profit
  FROM store_sales
  WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_store_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
),
sr_projected AS (
  SELECT sr_returned_date_sk, sr_customer_sk, sr_item_sk, sr_ticket_number, sr_net_loss
  FROM store_returns
  WHERE sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND sr_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND sr_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND sr_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
),
cs_projected AS (
  SELECT cs_sold_date_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_item_sk, cs_net_profit
  FROM catalog_sales
  WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND cs_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND cs_item_sk IS NOT NULL
),
item_projected AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id, i_item_desc
  FROM item
  WHERE i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
),
store_projected AS (
  SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_id, s_store_name
  FROM store
  WHERE s_store_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name,
  SUM(ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
  SUM(sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
  SUM(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM ss_projected
JOIN d1_filtered ON d1_filtered.d_date_sk = ss_projected.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN item_projected ON item_projected.i_item_sk = ss_projected.ss_item_sk
JOIN store_projected ON store_projected.s_store_sk = ss_projected.ss_store_sk
JOIN sr_projected ON sr_projected.sr_customer_sk = ss_projected.ss_customer_sk
  AND sr_projected.sr_item_sk = ss_projected.ss_item_sk
  AND sr_projected.sr_ticket_number = ss_projected.ss_ticket_number
JOIN d2_filtered ON d2_filtered.d_date_sk = sr_projected.sr_returned_date_sk
JOIN cs_projected ON cs_projected.cs_bill_customer_sk = sr_projected.sr_customer_sk
  AND cs_projected.cs_item_sk = sr_projected.sr_item_sk
JOIN d3_filtered ON d3_filtered.d_date_sk = cs_projected.cs_sold_date_sk
GROUP BY
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name
ORDER BY
  i_item_id,
  i_item_desc,
  s_store_id,
  s_store_name

  join 
    (select ca_address_sk, ca_state from customer_address) as ca_filtered
    on wr_filtered.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca_filtered.ca_address_sk
  join

  c_filtered.c_customer_id, c_filtered.c_salutation, c_filtered.c_first_name, c_filtered.c_last_name, c_filtered.c_preferred_cust_flag,

),
item_filtered AS (

),
wr_base AS (

    wr.wr_returning_customer_sk,
    ca.ca_state,
    wr.wr_reason_sk,
    wr.wr_return_amt

  JOIN date_filtered d ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN item_filtered i ON wr.wr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk

    AND wr.wr_reason_sk IN (9, 24)
),
customer_total_return AS (
  SELECT 
    wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,

  FROM wr_base
  GROUP BY wr_returning_customer_sk, ca_state, wr_reason_sk
),
state_thresholds AS (
  SELECT 
    ctr_state,
    AVG(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS threshold
  FROM customer_total_return

    SUM(CASE WHEN d_date < DATE '2000-05-08' THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,

    (
        SELECT
            cs_item_sk,

    INNER JOIN warehouse

WITH filtered_date AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN (CAST('2000-05-08' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '30' DAY)
                   AND (CAST('2000-05-08' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY)
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category = 'Books'
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 61 AND 100
),
filtered_catalog_sales AS (
  SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_order_number, cs_warehouse_sk
  FROM catalog_sales
  WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_date)
    AND cs_item_sk IN (SELECT i_item_sk FROM filtered_item)
    AND cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 81 AND 100
)
SELECT
  MIN(w.w_state) AS min_w_state,
  MIN(i.i_item_id) AS min_i_item_id,
  MIN(cs.cs_item_sk) AS min_cs_item_sk,
  MIN(cs.cs_order_number) AS min_cs_order_number,
  MIN(cr.cr_item_sk) AS min_cr_item_sk,
  MIN(cr.cr_order_number) AS min_cr_order_number
FROM filtered_catalog_sales cs
JOIN filtered_item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT cr_item_sk, cr_order_number

) cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number

    d_day.d_week_seq,
    ss.ss_store_sk,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day.d_day_name = 'Sunday') AS sun_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day.d_day_name = 'Monday') AS mon_sales,
    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day.d_day_name = 'Tuesday') AS tue_sales,

    SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) FILTER (WHERE d_day.d_day_name = 'Saturday') AS sat_sales
  FROM
    store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d_day ON d_day.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  WHERE
    ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN ss.ss_list_price * 0.17 AND ss.ss_list_price * 0.37
  GROUP BY

    ss.ss_store_sk
)

  s_store_name1,

  sun_sales1 / sun_sales2,
  mon_sales1 / mon_sales2,
  tue_sales1 / tue_sales2,

      wss.thu_sales AS thu_sales1,

      wss

WITH cs_ui AS (
  SELECT cs_item_sk,
         SUM(cs_ext_list_price) AS sale,
         SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit) AS refund
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY cs_item_sk
  HAVING SUM(cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit)
),
filtered_promotion AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
),
filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('W', 'D')
    AND cd_education_status IN ('College', '4 yr Degree')
),
filtered_ad2 AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_city, ca_zip
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL', 'OH')
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name, i_current_price
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 1 AND 11
),
filtered_date_dim AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2001
),
cross_sales AS (
  SELECT i.i_product_name AS product_name,
         i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
         s.s_store_name AS store_name,
         s.s_zip AS store_zip,
         ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
         ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
         ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
         ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
         ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
         ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
         ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
         ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
         d1.d_year AS syear,
         d2.d_year AS fsyear,
         d3.d_year AS s2year,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
         SUM(ss_list_price) AS s2,
         SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN cs_ui ON ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
  JOIN filtered_item i ON ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN store s ON ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN filtered_promotion ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
  JOIN filtered_ad2 ad2 ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
  JOIN filtered_cd cd1 ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN filtered_cd cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_dim d2 ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_date_dim d3 ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
  GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip,
           ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip,
           ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip,
           d1.d_year, d2.d_year, d3.d_year, i.i_product_name
  ORDER BY i.i_item_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip
)
SELECT cs1.product_name,
       cs1.store_name,
       cs1.store_zip,
       cs1.b_street_number,
       cs1.b_street_name,
       cs1.b_city,
       cs1.b_zip,
       cs1.c_street_number,
       cs1.c_street_name,
       cs1.c_city,
       cs1.c_zip,
       cs1.syear,
       cs1.cnt,
       cs1.s1 AS s11,
       cs1.s2 AS s21,
       cs1.s3 AS s31,
       cs2.s1 AS s12,
       cs2.s2 AS s22,
       cs2.s3 AS s32,
       cs2.syear,
       cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales cs1
JOIN cross_sales cs2 ON cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk
                     AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name
                     AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip
WHERE cs1.syear = 1999
  AND cs2.syear = 2000
  AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt
ORDER BY cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs2.cnt, cs1.s1, cs2.s1;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: 针对上一轮反馈的store_returns全表扫描问题（占比9.5%），调整cross_sales CTE内的JOIN顺序：先执行小表JOIN（cs_ui、filtered_item、filtered_promotion等预过滤CTE）形成小结果集，再将store_returns的JOIN移至最后，使用Nested Loop利用idx_store_returns_item索引或复合主键store_returns_pkey进行索引探测，避免Hash Join物化全表。具体改写：将'JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number'移至所有维度表JOIN之后，确保store_sales已被过滤到较小行数。

主查询中的cross_sales自连接(cs1 JOIN cs2)可改写为窗口函数消除自连接开销。使用LEAD/LAG窗口函数按(item_sk, store_name, store_zip)分区、按syear排序，直接获取相邻年份（1999和2000）的聚合结果，避免cross_sales CTE的21行输出自连接。具体改写：SELECT product_name, store_name, ..., syear, cnt, s1, s2, s3, LEAD(syear) OVER w AS next_year, LEAD(cnt) OVER w AS next_cnt, ... FROM cross_sales WHERE syear IN (1999, 2000) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY item_sk, store_name, store_zip ORDER BY syear) QUALIFY next_year = 2000 AND next_cnt <= cnt。

针对反馈中Incremental Sort失效问题，在cross_sales CTE的GROUP BY前增加预排序。由于最终查询ORDER BY cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs2.cnt, cs1.s1, cs2.s1，在CTE末尾的GROUP BY子句中调整分组列顺序为：GROUP BY i.i_item_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip（与ORDER BY前缀匹配），然后其他分组列。这样可使聚合后数据已按关键列有序，恢复Incremental Sort机会，减少全量排序代价。

合并filtered_cd1和filtered_cd2两个customer_demographics CTE，避免重复扫描。由于两者过滤条件完全相同（cd_marital_status IN ('W','D') AND cd_education_status IN ('College','4 yr Degree')），可改为单个filtered_cd CTE，在cross_sales中分别作为cd1和cd2两次引用。PostgreSQL查询优化器会识别相同CTE的多次引用并复用物化结果，减少一次全表扫描。

date_dim的三次JOIN（d1/d2/d3）当前无年份范围过滤。根据查询逻辑，最终结果仅保留syear=1999和2000的记录，可在filtered_date CTE中预过滤d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2001（覆盖c_first_sales_date_sk和c_first_shipto_date_sk可能的前后年份），减少date_dim JOIN输入行数。具体改写：创建filtered_date_dim CTE: SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_year BETWEEN 1998 AND 2001，然后在cross_sales中将d1/d2/d3的JOIN目标改为此CTE。

WITH cs_ui_filtered AS (
  SELECT cs.cs_item_sk
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk AND cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
  WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 65
  GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
  HAVING sum(cs.cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * sum(cr.cr_refunded_cash + cr.cr_reversed_charge + cr.cr_store_credit)
),
promotion_filtered AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' AND p_channel_tv = 'N' AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
),
item_filtered AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 18 AND 28
),
date_dim_2000 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2000
),
date_dim_2001 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
date_dim_all AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_year FROM date_dim WHERE d_year IN (2000, 2001)
),
customer_address_filtered AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_city, ca_zip, ca_state
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('NM', 'OK', 'TN')
),
customer_demographics_filtered AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('U', 'D', 'W') AND cd_education_status IN ('Secondary', '4 yr Degree', '2 yr Degree')
),
store_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_sold_date_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, ss_addr_sk, ss_store_sk, ss_promo_sk, ss_wholesale_cost, ss_list_price, ss_coupon_amt
  FROM store_sales
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 65
),
cross_sales_base AS (
  SELECT 
    i.i_product_name,
    i.i_item_sk,
    s.s_store_name,
    s.s_zip,
    ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
    ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
    ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
    ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
    ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
    ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
    ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
    ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
    d1.d_year AS syear,
    count(*) AS cnt,
    sum(ss.ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
    sum(ss.ss_list_price) AS s2,
    sum(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM store_sales_filtered ss
  JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  JOIN cs_ui_filtered cs_ui ON ss.ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
  JOIN item_filtered i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN date_dim_all d1 ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics_filtered cd1 ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_demographics_filtered cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
  JOIN customer_address_filtered ad2 ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_dim d3 ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  JOIN promotion_filtered p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
  GROUP BY i.i_product_name, i.i_item_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip, ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip, ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip, d1.d_year
),
cross_sales_2000 AS (
  SELECT * FROM cross_sales_base WHERE syear = 2000
),
cross_sales_2001 AS (
  SELECT * FROM cross_sales_base WHERE syear = 2001
)
SELECT 
  cs1.i_product_name AS product_name,
  cs1.s_store_name AS store_name,
  cs1.s_zip AS store_zip,
  cs1.b_street_number,
  cs1.b_street_name,
  cs1.b_city,
  cs1.b_zip,
  cs1.c_street_number,
  cs1.c_street_name,
  cs1.c_city,
  cs1.c_zip,
  cs1.syear,
  cs1.cnt,
  cs1.s1 AS s11,
  cs1.s2 AS s21,
  cs1.s3 AS s31,
  cs2.s1 AS s12,
  cs2.s2 AS s22,
  cs2.s3 AS s32,
  cs2.syear,
  cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales_2000 cs1
JOIN cross_sales_2001 cs2 ON cs1.i_item_sk = cs2.i_item_sk AND cs1.s_store_name = cs2.s_store_name AND cs1.s_zip = cs2.s_zip

WITH cs_ui AS (
  SELECT cs_item_sk,
         SUM(cs_ext_list_price) AS sale,
         SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit) AS refund
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY cs_item_sk
  HAVING SUM(cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * SUM(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit)
),
filtered_cd AS (
  SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
  FROM customer_demographics
  WHERE cd_marital_status IN ('D', 'U', 'S')
    AND cd_education_status IN ('College', 'Advanced Degree')
),
cross_sales AS (
  SELECT i.i_product_name AS product_name,
         i.i_item_sk AS item_sk,
         s.s_store_name AS store_name,
         s.s_zip AS store_zip,
         ad1.ca_street_number AS b_street_number,
         ad1.ca_street_name AS b_street_name,
         ad1.ca_city AS b_city,
         ad1.ca_zip AS b_zip,
         ad2.ca_street_number AS c_street_number,
         ad2.ca_street_name AS c_street_name,
         ad2.ca_city AS c_city,
         ad2.ca_zip AS c_zip,
         d1.d_year AS syear,
         d2.d_year AS fsyear,
         d3.d_year AS s2year,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         SUM(ss_wholesale_cost) AS s1,
         SUM(ss_list_price) AS s2,
         SUM(ss_coupon_amt) AS s3
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
  JOIN cs_ui ON ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_product_name
    FROM item
    WHERE i_current_price BETWEEN 17 AND 27
  ) i ON ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN store s ON ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim d2 ON c.c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_dim d3 ON c.c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_cd cd1 ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
  JOIN filtered_cd cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk AND cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
  JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_street_number, ca_street_name, ca_city, ca_zip
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('KS', 'MN', 'NV')
  ) ad2 ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
  JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
  JOIN (
    SELECT p_promo_sk
    FROM promotion
    WHERE p_channel_email = 'Y'
      AND p_channel_tv = 'N'
      AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
  ) p ON ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
  GROUP BY i.i_product_name, i.i_item_sk, s.s_store_name, s.s_zip,
           ad1.ca_street_number, ad1.ca_street_name, ad1.ca_city, ad1.ca_zip,
           ad2.ca_street_number, ad2.ca_street_name, ad2.ca_city, ad2.ca_zip,
           d1.d_year, d2.d_year, d3.d_year
)
SELECT cs1.product_name,
       cs1.store_name,
       cs1.store_zip,
       cs1.b_street_number,
       cs1.b_street_name,
       cs1.b_city,
       cs1.b_zip,
       cs1.c_street_number,
       cs1.c_street_name,
       cs1.c_city,
       cs1.c_zip,
       cs1.syear,
       cs1.cnt,
       cs1.s1 AS s11,
       cs1.s2 AS s21,
       cs1.s3 AS s31,
       cs2.s1 AS s12,
       cs2.s2 AS s22,
       cs2.s3 AS s32,
       cs2.syear,
       cs2.cnt
FROM cross_sales cs1
JOIN cross_sales cs2 ON cs1.item_sk = cs2.item_sk
                     AND cs1.store_name = cs2.store_name
                     AND cs1.store_zip = cs2.store_zip
                     AND cs2.cnt <= cs1.cnt
WHERE cs1.syear = 1998
  AND cs2.syear = 1999
ORDER BY cs1.product_name, cs1.store_name, cs2.cnt, cs1.s1, cs2.s1

original_query: select  	s_store_name, 	i_item_desc, 	sc.revenue, 	i_current_price, 	i_wholesale_cost, 	i_brand  from store, item,      (select ss_store_sk, avg(revenue) as ave  	from  	    (select  ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk,  		     sum(ss_sales_price) as revenue  		from store_sales, date_dim  		where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1178 and 1178+11     and ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 45 * 0.01 AND 55 * 0.01  		group by ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) sa  	group by ss_store_sk) sb,      (select  ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, sum(ss_sales_price) as revenue  	from store_sales, date_dim  	where ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_month_seq between 1178 and 1178+11   and ss_sales_price / ss_list_price BETWEEN 45 * 0.01 AND 55 * 0.01  	group by ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk) sc  where sb.ss_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk and        sc.revenue <= 0.1 * sb.ave and        s_store_sk = sc.ss_store_sk and        i_item_sk = sc.ss_item_sk        and i_manager_id BETWEEN 83 and 87        and s_state in ('IN','MI','WI')  order by s_store_name, i_item_desc limit 100;

WITH base_sales AS (
  SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM store_sales, date_dim
  WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1178 AND 1189
    AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN ss_list_price * 0.45 AND ss_list_price * 0.55
  GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk
),
store_avg AS (
  SELECT ss_store_sk, AVG(revenue) AS ave
  FROM base_sales
  GROUP BY ss_store_sk
)
SELECT s_store_name, i_item_desc, base_sales.revenue, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand
FROM store, item, store_avg, base_sales
WHERE store_avg.ss_store_sk = base_sales.ss_store_sk
  AND base_sales.revenue <= 0.1 * store_avg.ave
  AND s_store_sk = base_sales.ss_store_sk
  AND i_item_sk = base_sales.ss_item_sk
  AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 83 AND 87
  AND s_state IN ('IN', 'MI', 'WI')
ORDER BY s_store_name, i_item_desc
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_date AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_moy BETWEEN 9 AND 11
),
store_customers AS (

  JOIN filtered_date ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 5 AND 94

rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_customer_address AS (
    SELECT * FROM customer_address WHERE ca_state IN ('MD', 'MO', 'OK')
),
store_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2002
      AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 7
      AND ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 132 AND 221
    GROUP BY ss_customer_sk
),
web_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2002
      AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 7
      AND ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 132 AND 221

),
catalog_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_year = 2002
      AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 5 AND 7
      AND cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 132 AND 221
    GROUP BY cs_ship_customer_sk
)
SELECT
    cd.cd_gender,
    cd.cd_marital_status,
    cd.cd_education_status,
    COUNT(*) cnt1,
    cd.cd_purchase_estimate,
    COUNT(*) cnt2,
    cd.cd_credit_rating,

    JOIN filtered_customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk

original_query: select  i_item_desc       ,w_warehouse_name       ,d1.d_week_seq       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is null then 1 else 0 end) no_promo       ,sum(case when p_promo_sk is not null then 1 else 0 end) promo       ,count(*) total_cnt from catalog_sales join inventory on (cs_item_sk = inv_item_sk) join warehouse on (w_warehouse_sk=inv_warehouse_sk) join item on (i_item_sk = cs_item_sk) join customer_demographics on (cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk) join household_demographics on (cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd_demo_sk) join date_dim d1 on (cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk) join date_dim d2 on (inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk) join date_dim d3 on (cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk) left outer join promotion on (cs_promo_sk=p_promo_sk) left outer join catalog_returns on (cr_item_sk = cs_item_sk and cr_order_number = cs_order_number) where d1.d_week_seq = d2.d_week_seq   and inv_quantity_on_hand < cs_quantity   and d3.d_date > d1.d_date + interval '3 day'   and hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'   and d1.d_year = 2001   and cd_marital_status = 'U'   and cd_dep_count between 5 and 7   and i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')   and cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100 group by i_item_desc,w_warehouse_name,d1.d_week_seq order by total_cnt desc, i_item_desc, w_warehouse_name, d_week_seq limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH valid_weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d_week_seq
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 2001
),
filtered_cs AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.cs_item_sk,
    cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk,
    cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk,
    cs.cs_sold_date_sk,
    cs.cs_ship_date_sk,
    cs.cs_promo_sk,
    cs.cs_order_number,
    cs.cs_quantity
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 80 AND 100
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM item i
      WHERE i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
        AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM customer_demographics cd
      WHERE cd.cd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk
        AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'U'
        AND cd.cd_dep_count BETWEEN 5 AND 7
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM household_demographics hd
      WHERE hd.hd_demo_sk = cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk
        AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
    )
)
SELECT
  i.i_item_desc,
  w.w_warehouse_name,
  d1.d_week_seq,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_promo_sk IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_promo,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_promo_sk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo,
  COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
FROM
  filtered_cs cs
JOIN
  date_dim d1
  ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
  AND d1.d_year = 2001
JOIN
  inventory inv
  ON inv.inv_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  AND inv.inv_quantity_on_hand < cs.cs_quantity
JOIN
  date_dim d2
  ON inv.inv_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  AND d2.d_week_seq = d1.d_week_seq
  AND d2.d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM valid_weeks)
JOIN
  warehouse w
  ON w.w_warehouse_sk = inv.inv_warehouse_sk
JOIN
  item i
  ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  AND i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports')
JOIN
  customer_demographics cd
  ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
  AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'U'
  AND cd.cd_dep_count BETWEEN 5 AND 7
JOIN
  household_demographics hd
  ON cs.cs_bill_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  AND hd.hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000'
JOIN
  date_dim d3
  ON cs.cs_ship_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
  AND d3.d_date > d1.d_date + INTERVAL '3 day'

WITH filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category = 'Sports'
),
filtered_date_1999 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999
),
filtered_date_1998 AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1998
),
cs_sales AS (
  SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, i.i_manufact_id,
         cs.cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity, 0) AS sales_cnt,
         cs.cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0.0) AS sales_amt
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN filtered_item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
                               AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
  WHERE cs.cs_sales_price >= 0.8 * cs.cs_list_price
    AND cs.cs_sales_price <= cs.cs_list_price
    AND d.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    AND (cr.cr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45) OR cr.cr_reason_sk IS NULL)
),
ss_sales AS (
  SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, i.i_manufact_id,
         ss.ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity, 0) AS sales_cnt,
         ss.ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0.0) AS sales_amt
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN filtered_item i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
                             AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
  WHERE ss.ss_sales_price >= 0.8 * ss.ss_list_price
    AND ss.ss_sales_price <= ss.ss_list_price
    AND d.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    AND (sr.sr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45) OR sr.sr_reason_sk IS NULL)
),
ws_sales AS (
  SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, i.i_manufact_id,
         ws.ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity, 0) AS sales_cnt,
         ws.ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0.0) AS sales_amt
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN filtered_item i ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
                           AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
  WHERE ws.ws_sales_price >= 0.8 * ws.ws_list_price
    AND ws.ws_sales_price <= ws.ws_list_price
    AND d.d_year IN (1998, 1999)
    AND (wr.wr_reason_sk IN (7, 10, 12, 29, 45) OR wr.wr_reason_sk IS NULL)
),
all_sales AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt,
         SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM cs_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ss_sales
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM ws_sales
  ) sales_detail
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
)
SELECT prev_yr.d_year AS prev_year,
       curr_yr.d_year AS year,
       curr_yr.i_brand_id,
       curr_yr.i_class_id,
       curr_yr.i_category_id,
       curr_yr.i_manufact_id,
       prev_yr.sales_cnt AS prev_yr_cnt,
       curr_yr.sales_cnt AS curr_yr_cnt,
       curr_yr.sales_cnt - prev_yr.sales_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff,
       curr_yr.sales_amt - prev_yr.sales_amt AS sales_amt_diff
FROM all_sales curr_yr
JOIN all_sales prev_yr ON curr_yr.i_brand_id = prev_yr.i_brand_id
                       AND curr_yr.i_class_id = prev_yr.i_class_id
                       AND curr_yr.i_category_id = prev_yr.i_category_id
                       AND curr_yr.i_manufact_id = prev_yr.i_manufact_id
                       AND curr_yr.d_year = 1999
                       AND prev_yr.d_year = 1998
WHERE prev_yr.sales_cnt > 0
  AND CAST(curr_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2)) / CAST(prev_yr.sales_cnt AS DECIMAL(17,2)) < 0.9
ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff
LIMIT 100

WITH filtered_date AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-08-11' AS DATE)
    AND CAST('2001-08-11' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
filtered_item AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_category
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price > 50
    AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports')
),
filtered_promotion AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'N'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND p_channel_event = 'Y'
),
ssr AS (
  SELECT
    s.s_store_id AS store_id,
    SUM(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(ss.ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr.sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM store_sales ss
  INNER JOIN filtered_date fd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item fi ON ss.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promotion fp ON ss.ss_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk
  INNER JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  LEFT JOIN store_returns sr ON ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
    AND ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number
  WHERE ss.ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  GROUP BY s.s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT
    cp.cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(cs.cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr.cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  INNER JOIN filtered_date fd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item fi ON cs.cs_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promotion fp ON cs.cs_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk
  INNER JOIN catalog_page cp ON cs.cs_catalog_page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
  LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr ON cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
    AND cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number
  WHERE cs.cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT
    w.web_site_id,
    SUM(ws.ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
    SUM(ws.ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr.wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM web_sales ws
  INNER JOIN filtered_date fd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = fd.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_item fi ON ws.ws_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN filtered_promotion fp ON ws.ws_promo_sk = fp.p_promo_sk
  INNER JOIN web_site w ON ws.ws_web_site_sk = w.web_site_sk
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
    AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
  WHERE ws.ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 45 AND 60
  GROUP BY w.web_site_id
),
base_data AS (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, 'store' || store_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, 'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, 'web_site' || web_site_id AS id, sales, returns, profit FROM wsr
),
channel_id_agg AS (
  SELECT channel, id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit
  FROM base_data
  GROUP BY channel, id
),
channel_agg AS (
  SELECT channel, NULL AS id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit
  FROM base_data
  GROUP BY channel
),
total_agg AS (
  SELECT NULL AS channel, NULL AS id, SUM(sales) AS sales, SUM(returns) AS returns, SUM(profit) AS profit
  FROM base_data
)
SELECT channel, id, sales, returns, profit FROM channel_id_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT channel, id, sales, returns, profit FROM channel_agg
UNION ALL
SELECT channel, id, sales, returns, profit FROM total_agg
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

WITH date_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('1998-11-14' AS DATE) AND CAST('1998-11-14' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30' DAY
),
item_filtered AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_category
  FROM item
  WHERE i_current_price > 50
    AND i_category IN ('Books', 'Home')
),
promo_filtered AS (
  SELECT p_promo_sk
  FROM promotion
  WHERE p_channel_email = 'N'
    AND p_channel_tv = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_radio = 'Y'
    AND p_channel_press = 'N'
    AND p_channel_event = 'N'
),
ssr AS (
  SELECT s_store_id AS store_id,
         SUM(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(sr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(ss_net_profit - COALESCE(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM store_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN store_returns ON (ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number)
  INNER JOIN date_filtered ON ss_sold_date_sk = date_filtered.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
  INNER JOIN item_filtered ON ss_item_sk = item_filtered.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN promo_filtered ON ss_promo_sk = promo_filtered.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ss_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 72
  GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr AS (
  SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
         SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(cs_net_profit - COALESCE(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM catalog_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number)
  INNER JOIN date_filtered ON cs_sold_date_sk = date_filtered.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN catalog_page ON cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
  INNER JOIN item_filtered ON cs_item_sk = item_filtered.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN promo_filtered ON cs_promo_sk = promo_filtered.p_promo_sk
  WHERE cs_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 72
  GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
  SELECT web_site_id,
         SUM(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
         SUM(COALESCE(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns,
         SUM(ws_net_profit - COALESCE(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
  FROM web_sales
  LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON (ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number)
  INNER JOIN date_filtered ON ws_sold_date_sk = date_filtered.d_date_sk
  INNER JOIN web_site ON ws_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
  INNER JOIN item_filtered ON ws_item_sk = item_filtered.i_item_sk
  INNER JOIN promo_filtered ON ws_promo_sk = promo_filtered.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 57 AND 72
  GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(returns) AS returns,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
  SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
         'store' || store_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM ssr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
         'catalog_page' || catalog_page_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM csr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
         'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
         sales,
         returns,
         profit
  FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100;

WITH valid_date_sks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d1.d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim d1
  WHERE d1.d_month_seq IN (
    SELECT d2.d_month_seq
    FROM date_dim d2
    WHERE d2.d_date IN ('1998-03-05','1998-06-15','1998-09-12','1998-10-31')
  )
),
filtered_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk, i_item_id
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Books', 'Sports')
    AND i_manager_id BETWEEN 36 AND 45
),
sr_agg AS (
  SELECT sr_item_sk, SUM(sr_return_quantity) AS sr_item_qty
  FROM store_returns
  WHERE sr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM valid_date_sks)
    AND sr_return_amt / NULLIF(sr_return_quantity, 0) BETWEEN 141 AND 170
    AND sr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
  GROUP BY sr_item_sk
),
cr_agg AS (
  SELECT cr_item_sk, SUM(cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty
  FROM catalog_returns
  WHERE cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM valid_date_sks)
    AND cr_return_amount / NULLIF(cr_return_quantity, 0) BETWEEN 141 AND 170
    AND cr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
  GROUP BY cr_item_sk
),

  SELECT wr_item_sk, SUM(wr_return_quantity) AS wr_item_qty
  FROM web_returns
  WHERE wr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM valid_date_sks)
    AND wr_return_amt / NULLIF(wr_return_quantity, 0) BETWEEN 141 AND 170
    AND wr_reason_sk IN (6, 29, 42, 45, 62)
  GROUP BY wr_item_sk
),

),

  sr_items.item_id,

  sr_items.sr_item_qty / (sr_items.sr_item_qty + cr_items.cr_item_qty + wr_items.wr_item_qty) / 3.0 * 100 AS sr_dev,

  wr_items.wr_item_qty,

FROM sr_items

store_sales_filtered AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN filtered_date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = filtered_date_dim.d_date_sk
  JOIN filtered_customer ON store_sales.ss_customer_sk = filtered_customer.c_customer_sk
  WHERE ss_list_price BETWEEN 271 AND 300

),
catalog_sales_filtered AS (

),

FROM (

  EXCEPT

rewritten_query:
WITH filtered_date AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1999 AND d_moy = 5
),
filtered_household_demographics AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_buy_potential LIKE '0-500%'
),
filtered_customer_demographics AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE (cd_marital_status = 'M' AND cd_education_status = 'Unknown')
       OR (cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree')
),
filtered_customer_address AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_gmt_offset = -7
),
filtered_catalog_returns AS (
    SELECT cr_call_center_sk, cr_returning_customer_sk, cr_net_loss, cr_item_sk, cr_order_number
    FROM catalog_returns
    WHERE cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM filtered_date)
),
filtered_customer AS (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_current_cdemo_sk, c.c_current_hdemo_sk, c.c_current_addr_sk
    FROM customer c
    INNER JOIN filtered_customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    INNER JOIN filtered_household_demographics hd ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
)
SELECT
    MIN(cc.cc_call_center_id),
    MIN(cc.cc_name),
    MIN(cc.cc_manager),
    MIN(cr.cr_net_loss),
    MIN(cr.cr_item_sk),
    MIN(cr.cr_order_number)
FROM call_center cc
INNER JOIN filtered_catalog_returns cr ON cr.cr_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
INNER JOIN filtered_customer c ON cr.cr_returning_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk

WITH avg_discount AS (
  SELECT 
    ws_item_sk,
    1.3 * AVG(ws_ext_discount_amt) AS threshold
  FROM 
    web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ws_sold_date_sk
  WHERE 
    d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-11' AND '2002-05-12'
    AND ws_wholesale_cost BETWEEN 68 AND 88
  GROUP BY ws_item_sk
)

  SUM(ws.ws_ext_discount_amt) AS "Excess Discount Amount"
FROM 
  item i
  JOIN web_sales ws ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
  JOIN avg_discount ad ON ad.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
WHERE 
  (i.i_manufact_id BETWEEN 394 AND 593 OR i.i_category IN ('Books', 'Home', 'Sports'))
  AND d.d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-11' AND '2002-05-12'

LIMIT 100;

rewritten_query:
WITH d1_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_year = 1999
    AND d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
),
item_filtered AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE i_category IN ('Home', 'Men', 'Music')
    AND i_item_sk IS NOT NULL
),
ca_filtered AS (
  SELECT ca_address_sk
  FROM customer_address
  WHERE ca_state IN ('MS', 'NC', 'NM', 'OK', 'TN')
    AND ca_address_sk IS NOT NULL
),
hd_filtered AS (
  SELECT hd_demo_sk
  FROM household_demographics
  WHERE hd_income_band_sk BETWEEN 14 AND 20
    AND hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000'
    AND hd_demo_sk IS NOT NULL
),
sr_filtered AS (
  SELECT sr_item_sk, sr_ticket_number, sr_returned_date_sk
  FROM store_returns
  WHERE sr_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND sr_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
    AND sr_returned_date_sk IS NOT NULL
),
ss_filtered AS (
  SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales
  WHERE ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_ticket_number IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ss_list_price > 0
    AND ss_sales_price BETWEEN ss_list_price * 0.57 AND ss_list_price * 0.77
),
ws_filtered AS (
  SELECT ws_item_sk, ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_sold_date_sk
  FROM web_sales
  WHERE ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ws_bill_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
    AND ws_sold_date_sk IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM ss_filtered
JOIN sr_filtered ON ss_filtered.ss_ticket_number = sr_filtered.sr_ticket_number
  AND ss_filtered.ss_item_sk = sr_filtered.sr_item_sk
JOIN ws_filtered ON ss_filtered.ss_customer_sk = ws_filtered.ws_bill_customer_sk
  AND ss_filtered.ss_item_sk = ws_filtered.ws_item_sk
JOIN d1_filtered ON sr_filtered.sr_returned_date_sk = d1_filtered.d_date_sk
JOIN date_dim d2 ON ws_filtered.ws_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
  AND d2.d_date BETWEEN d1_filtered.d_date AND (d1_filtered.d_date + INTERVAL '90' day)
  AND d2.d_date_sk IS NOT NULL
JOIN item_filtered ON ss_filtered.ss_item_sk = item_filtered.i_item_sk
JOIN customer c ON ss_filtered.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  AND c.c_customer_sk IS NOT NULL
JOIN ca_filtered ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca_filtered.ca_address_sk
JOIN hd_filtered ON c.c_current_hdemo_sk = hd_filtered.hd_demo_sk
GROUP BY c.c_customer_sk, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
ORDER BY cnt
